scope: Every tracked blob at source_commit, excluding generated results/evidence-audit/. No ignored/live files or external services.
limitations: Automated structural and arithmetic checks are not manual semantic review of every note, prompt or scientific conclusion.
No ChemSep reruns, independent physical validation, remote retrieval, full Git-history credential audit or billing-provider reconciliation.
Embedded HTML/JavaScript is scanned as text, not executed; standalone JSON/JSONL is authoritative for record checks.
Repeated exports are counted as file occurrences, not independent experiments. Missing raw records remain unverified.
